name: ST NUCLEO-H723ZG (Nucleo-144)
description: Fastest Nucleo-144 in this set: 550 MHz Cortex-M7 with 1 MB flash, Ethernet RJ45, USB OTG and ST-LINK, plus Arduino Uno V3 and morpho headers.
notes: STM32H723 has a USB OTG HS controller that needs an external ULPI PHY for 480 Mbit/s; the board's user USB port runs full-speed. 100 GPIO is an estimate of what reaches the connectors.
KiCad footprint is the common Nucleo-144 morpho connector footprint (no dedicated symbol for this board).
Price is the ST eStore list price seen in late 2026 (US tariff-era pricing); older articles quote lower numbers, so re-check before ordering.
